handoff: F1-F5 fixed and verified; restore_markers sound (traced, no receipt/state, rule case + golden); only the 3 ruled skips remain (->13, 14, 10/11); e2e 71/2 skip; 3 minor findings (.env.norn not restored, view parity until next tick, self-take receipt).

findings.title: restore_markers restores .norn-unit but not .env.norn
findings.detail:
`git clean -fdx` also removes the ignored .env.norn (port slot, R8 env). AC2 is met (same step, attempt and counters), but an agent relaunched in that worktree before anything rewrites .env.norn would lack it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Check whether launch rewrites .env.norn; if not, restore it alongside the marker in a later slice.

findings.title: The view finds no worktree whose marker is gone until a tick restores it
findings.detail:
observe reads such a worktree by its inferred marker, but loadProjectView/scanWorktrees require .norn-unit. Between `git clean` and the next tick, `norn status` and observe can disagree about that worktree. The window is short and the inbox parity snapshots are not affected.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally let scanWorktrees fall back to inferUnitMarker as well.

findings.title: Remaking a worktree still appends a self-take receipt (from review#1 F8, still open)
findings.detail:
checkoutStory writes a take receipt and a trace event when story start remakes the worktree, and slice worktrees are not remade. The race and the silent-catch parts of F8 are fixed. Not blocking.
Axis: spec
